final: WITH grouped_data AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), country_totals AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(group_count) as country_total FROM grouped_data WHERE death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY death_country) SELECT gd.player_id, gd.death_country, gd.group_count, CAST(gd.group_count AS FLOAT) / ct.country_total as ratio FROM grouped_data gd LEFT JOIN country_totals ct ON gd.death_country = ct.death_country WHERE ct.country_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
